title: Everpure Purity SyslogConnector
descriptionMarkdown:
The Everpure arrays data connector ingests Syslog alerts from Everpure arrays into Microsoft Sentinel. Logs are collected using the Azure Monitor Agent (AMA) via the Microsoft **Syslog via AMA** solution. The `PureStorageFlashArrayParserV1` and `PureStorageFlashBladeParserV1` Kusto functions parse the ingested events.

[Learn more about the Syslog via AMA connector >](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/connect-syslog)
additionalRequirementBanner: This data connector depends on the [**PureStorageFlashArrayParserV1**](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Pure%20Storage/Parsers/PureStorageFlashArrayParser.yaml) and [**PureStorageFlashBladeParserV1**](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Pure%20Storage/Parsers/PureStorageFlashBladeParser.yaml) Kusto function parsers, which are deployed with the Microsoft Sentinel solution.

sampleQueries.query:
Syslog
| where SyslogMessage has "purity.alert"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Everpure Storage Array events - last 24 hours
sampleQueries.query:
Syslog
| where SyslogMessage has "purity.alert"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: Syslog (EverpureSyslog)
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
Syslog
| where SyslogMessage has "purity.alert"
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
Syslog
| where SyslogMessage has "purity.alert"
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)

customs.description: To collect data from non-Azure VMs, they must have Azure Arc installed and enabled. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/agents/azure-monitor-agent-install)

The **Syslog via AMA** solution must be installed in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. [Install from Microsoft Marketplace](https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/azuresentinel.azure-sentinel-solution-syslog)

instructionSteps.title: 1. Review the parser dependency
instructionSteps.description: This data connector depends on the [**PureStorageFlashArrayParserV1**](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Pure%20Storage/Parsers/PureStorageFlashArrayParser.yaml) and [**PureStorageFlashBladeParserV1**](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/blob/master/Solutions/Pure%20Storage/Parsers/PureStorageFlashBladeParser.yaml) Kusto functions, which are deployed with this Microsoft Sentinel solution.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure Everpure arrays to forward Syslog messages
instructionSteps.description: Configure your Everpure arrays to forward Syslog alert messages containing `purity.alert` to a Linux log forwarder machine on port 514 over UDP or TCP.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Install the Syslog via AMA solution
instructionSteps.description:
This connector relies on the Microsoft **Syslog via AMA** solution to collect Syslog data into your workspace using the Azure Monitor Agent. Install it from Microsoft Marketplace, onboard a Linux log forwarder, and create a Data Collection Rule that collects the Syslog facilities and severities used by your Everpure arrays.

[Install Syslog via AMA from Microsoft Marketplace](https://marketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/product/azuresentinel.azure-sentinel-solution-syslog)
